Name: Elegant Pretence
Author: stanzhang
Description:
Description

Elegant Pretence (优雅的装模作样)

You still fish.

You still play the minigame.

You still feel like you earned the catch.

You just can’t fail anymore.

Elegant Pretence expands the fishing bar to a configurable size, making fishing effectively impossible to fail while preserving the original Stardew Valley fishing experience.

No auto-fishing.

No instant catches.

No skipped gameplay.

Just a slightly ridiculous amount of confidence.

The name comes from a Chinese phrase I jokingly describe as “Elegant Pretence” — you’re still doing the fishing minigame, still moving the bar, still looking like you’re earning every catch.

But in reality, you’re not going to fail.

It’s fishing with dignity preserved.

Installation Instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Enjoy fishing without frustration.[/*]
[/list]Main Features
• Preserves the original fishing minigame.
• Makes fish escapes virtually impossible.
• Treasure chests work normally.
• Lightweight and simple.
• Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.
• Configurable fishing bar size through the config file.
Requirements
• SMAPI 4.0 or later.
• Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.
Shout Outs
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI developers, and everyone who shares modding knowledge and tools that make learning and creating mods possible.
Special thanks to ChatGPT for helping a first-time mod author learn C#, SMAPI modding, Git, GitHub, debugging, packaging, and publishing.
